about: MANZZA Industry Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer specializing in electrical steel laminations used in transformer core construction. Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, MANZZA serves transformer manufacturers across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu. Our focus is on precision-cut electrical steel laminations, consistent manufacturing, customer-specific specifications and dependable B2B supply.

intro.headline: Precision-engineered transformer laminations.
intro.lede: At MANZZA Industry Pvt. Ltd., we manufacture electrical steel laminations for transformer core applications, combining precision processing with a commitment to consistent quality and dependable supply.

process.text: Precision cutting of electrical steel laminations according to the required dimensions, profiles and production specifications.
Punching for components that require specified holes or profiles, supporting customized and repeat production requirements.

process.step: Step-lap processing and core stacking support
process.text: Manufacturing processes supporting mitre-core geometries and the required arrangement of laminations for step-lap core construction.
Additional cutting and material-processing operations to support different lamination profiles and manufacturing requirements.
